title: ABH Healthcare IPO Details
intro:
ABH Healthcare IPO is a book build issue of ₹34.98 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 0.34 crore shares of ₹34.98 crore.

ABH Healthcare IPO opens for subscription on Aug 24, 2026 and closes on Aug 26, 2026. The allotment for the ABH Healthcare IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 27, 2026. ABH Healthcare IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 31, 2026.

ABH Healthcare IPO is set issue price band at ₹96 to ₹102 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,44,800 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,67,200.

Fedex Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to ABH Healthcare IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: ABH Healthcare Ltd provides healthcare services, operates under the name "Anil Baghi Hospital". The company has 150 beds and offer 25 medical specialities, including cardiac sciences, neurology, minimally invasive spine and brain surgeries, medical and surgical gastroenterology, laparoscopic and bariatric surgery, urology, pulmonology, nephrology, ENT, maxillofacial surgeries, etc. The hospital has empaneled with 30 private and public health insurance providers and third-party administrators. We also participate in major government healthcare schemes such as the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS), Railways, Food Corporation of India (FCI), Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL), and Ayushman Bharat - Sarbat Sehat Bima Yojana (ABSSBY).
As of March 31, 2025, it has 29 doctors and 137 nurses.

faqs.question: How to apply in ABH Healthcare IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in ABH Healthcare IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in ABH Healthcare IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in ABH Healthcare IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' ABH Healthcare IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When ABH Healthcare IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The ABH Healthcare IPO opens on Mon, Aug 24, 2026 and closes on Wed, Aug 26, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of ABH Healthcare IPO?
faqs.answer: ABH Healthcare IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,44,800 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for ABH Healthcare IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in ABH Healthcare IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is ABH Healthcare IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for ABH Healthcare IPO will be done on Thursday, August 27, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Aug 28, 2026 . Check the ABH Healthcare IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is ABH Healthcare IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The ABH Healthcare IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Aug 31, 2026 .
